priorityList: Maintain Battle Stance at all times and use Pummel to interrupt casts.
Use Thunder Clap to apply and refresh Rend on all targets.
Cast Ravager when Colossus Smash (or Warbreaker) is nearly ready (less than 3 seconds).
Cast Avatar and Colossus Smash (or Warbreaker) together to initiate your burst window.
Cast Champion's Spear while the Colossus Smash debuff is active.
Cast Demolish once you reach 10 stacks of Colossal Might.
Cast Cleave as your primary priority Rage spender in AoE situations.
Cast Demolish if the Colossus Smash debuff is active on the target, even if below 10 stacks.
Cast Whirlwind if you have the Fervor of Battle talent and 3 stacks of Collateral Damage.
Cast Mortal Strike to consume Martial Prowess stacks or if Cleave is unavailable.
Cast Overpower to generate Martial Prowess and buff your next Cleave/Mortal Strike.
Cast Execute whenever Sudden Death procs or if the target enters the Execute health threshold.
Cast Sweeping Strikes if Broad Strokes is not talented and Colossus Smash is on cooldown.
Use Bladestorm as a low-priority filler when other higher-priority abilities are on cooldown.
Use offensive racials and damage trinkets during the Colossus Smash debuff window.
